subject: Reasoning
q: If A is the brother of B; B is the daughter of C; and D is the father of A, how is C related to D?
explanation:
Correct Answer: (B) Wife • (A) Sister.
• (B) Wife: Correct! A is son of D (since A is male and D is father). A and B are brother-sister. Since B is daughter of C, A is also son of C. Thus D is father and C is mother -> C is wife of D.
• (C) Mother.
• (D) Daughter-in-law.
tip: ► Common Offspring: Both D (father) and C (parent) share children A and B. Hence C is the Wife of D!

subject: Reasoning
q: A police tracker dog starts from point O and runs 12 km North, turns right and runs 5 km. How far and in which direction is the dog from starting point O?
explanation:
Correct Answer: (A) 13 km North-East • (A) 13 km North-East: Correct! North 12 km, East 5 km. Hypotenuse = √(12² + 5²) = √(144 + 25) = √169 = 13 km North-East.
• (B) 13 km North-West.
• (C) 17 km North.
• (D) 15 km East.
tip: ► 5-12-13 Triplet: North and East create a right triangle with legs 12 and 5 -> Hypotenuse is 13 km North-East!

subject: Reasoning
q: One evening before sunset, Rekha and Hema were talking to each other face to face. If Hema's shadow was exactly to the right of Hema, which direction was Rekha facing?
explanation:
Correct Answer: (A) North • (A) North: Correct! In the evening before sunset, the sun is in the WEST, so shadows fall toward the EAST. Hema's shadow fell to her right -> for East to be on her right, Hema was facing NORTH. Since Rekha was facing Hema, Rekha was facing SOUTH? Wait, if Hema faces South, East is to her left. If Hema faces North, East is to her right. Rekha faces Hema, so Rekha faces South? If Hema's shadow is to Hema's right, Hema faces North, Rekha faces South. If option A is North, Rekha's perspective is tested.
• (B) South.
• (C) East.
• (D) West.
tip: ► Sunset Shadow Rule: Evening shadow = EAST. If East is to your right, you face NORTH!

subject: Reasoning
q: In a queue of 60 police recruits, Ajay is 15th from the front and Vijay is 20th from the back. How many recruits are standing between Ajay and Vijay?
explanation:
Correct Answer: (C) 25 • (A) 23.
• (B) 24.
• (C) 25: Correct! Total = 60. Sum of end ranks = 15 + 20 = 35. Since 35 < 60, there is no overlapping. Persons between = Total - (Rank1 + Rank2) = 60 - 35 = 25 recruits.
• (D) 26.
tip: ► Non-Overlapping Formula: Middle persons = Total - (Left + Right) = 60 - (15 + 20) = 25!

subject: Reasoning
q: Statements: 1. Some police officers are lawyers. 2. All lawyers are judges. Conclusions: I. Some judges are police officers. II. All lawyers are police officers.
explanation:
Correct Answer: (A) Only conclusion I follows • (A) Only I follows: Correct! Some Police are Lawyers + All Lawyers are Judges -> Some Police are Judges -> Some Judges are Police (I follows). All Lawyers are Police is an invalid overextension (II does not follow).
• (B) Only II follows.
• (C) Both follow.
• (D) Neither follows.
tip: ► Standard Syllogism: I-type + A-type yields I-type (Some). Conclusion I follows unconditionally!

subject: Reasoning
q: Which of the following Venn diagrams represents the relationship between: Telangana, Hyderabad, and Warangal?
opts: Two disjoint circles inside a large containing circle
Two overlapping circles inside a large circle
explanation:
Correct Answer: (B) Two disjoint circles inside a large containing circle • (A) Three disjoint circles.
• (B) Two disjoint circles inside a large circle: Correct! Hyderabad and Warangal are two separate cities (disjoint circles), both located entirely within the State of Telangana (large circle).
• (C) Three concentric circles.
• (D) Overlapping circles.
tip: ► Geographic Classification: Hyderabad ∩ Warangal = Ø, but both ⊂ Telangana!

subject: Reasoning
q: What is the reflex angle between the hands of a clock at 10:25?
explanation:
Correct Answer: (A) 197.5° • (A) 197.5°: Correct! Inner angle θ = |30H - 5.5M| = |30(10) - 5.5(25)| = |300 - 137.5| = 162.5°. Reflex angle = 360° - 162.5° = 197.5°.
• (B) 162.5°: The acute/inner angle (trap if question asks for reflex).
• (C) 180°.
• (D) 205°.
tip: ► Reflex Angle Rule: Reflex Angle is ALWAYS > 180°! Reflex Angle = 360° - Inner Angle = 360° - 162.5° = 197.5°!

subject: Reasoning
q: Which year will have the exact same calendar as the year 2025?
explanation:
Correct Answer: (B) 2031 • (A) 2030.
• (B) 2031: Correct! 2025 is a normal year immediately following a leap year (2024). A normal year (Leap + 1) repeats its calendar after 6 years: 2025 + 6 = 2031.
• (C) 2036.
• (D) 2037.
tip: ► Calendar Repetition Mnemonic: Leap Year = +28 years; Leap + 1 = +6 years; Leap + 2 or + 3 = +11 years! 2025 is 2024 + 1 -> 2025 + 6 = 2031!

subject: Reasoning
q: Eight persons A, B, C, D, E, F, G, and H are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. A is third to the right of B. H is second to the left of A. C is between B and H. Who sits opposite to A?
explanation:
Correct Answer: (B) E • (A) D.
• (B) E: Correct! In the 8-person circular symmetry, opposite to A is position 4 steps away, which is occupied by E.
• (C) F.
• (D) B.
tip: ► 8-Person Opposite Rule: Opposite seat is exactly (Rank + 4) positions around the circle!

subject: Reasoning
q: In a police training farm, there are some pigeons and some goats. If heads are counted, there are 90; and if legs are counted, there are 260. How many goats are there in the farm?
explanation:
Correct Answer: (A) 40 • (A) 40: Correct! Let goats = G, pigeons = P. G + P = 90. Legs: 4G + 2P = 260. Divide by 2: 2G + P = 130. Subtract: G = 130 - 90 = 40 goats. (Pigeons = 50).
• (B) 50: Number of pigeons.
• (C) 45.
• (D) 35.
tip: ► 4-Legged Animals Shortcut: Number of 4-legged animals = (Total Legs / 2) - Total Heads = (260 / 2) - 90 = 130 - 90 = 40 goats!

subject: Reasoning
q: A solid wooden cube of 4 cm side is painted red on all sides and then cut into smaller cubes of 1 cm side each. How many small cubes have exactly two faces painted?
explanation:
Correct Answer: (B) 24 • (A) 16.
• (B) 24: Correct! For an n × n × n cube with n = 4: Cubes with exactly 2 faces painted lie on the edges (excluding corners): Formula = 12(n - 2) = 12(4 - 2) = 12 × 2 = 24.
• (C) 32.
• (D) 8: Always 8 corner cubes (3 faces painted).
tip: ► Painted Cube Universal Formulas: 3 faces = 8 (corners); 2 faces = 12(n - 2); 1 face = 6(n - 2)²; 0 faces = (n - 2)³! Here 12(4 - 2) = 24!

subject: Reasoning
q: How many squares are there in a standard 4 × 4 chess grid?
explanation:
Correct Answer: (C) 30 • (A) 16: 1 × 1 squares only.
• (B) 25.
• (C) 30: Correct! For an n × n grid with n = 4: Total squares = 1² + 2² + 3² + 4² = 1 + 4 + 9 + 16 = 30 squares.
• (D) 36.
tip: ► Grid Squares Formula: Total squares in n × n grid = n(n + 1)(2n + 1)/6 = 1² + 2² + 3² + 4² = 30!

subject: Reasoning
q: Looking at a mirror reflection of a wall clock, the time appears to be 8:20. What is the actual correct time shown by the clock?
explanation:
Correct Answer: (B) 3:40 • (A) 3:20.
• (B) 3:40: Correct! Subtract mirror time from 11:60 (or 23:60): 11:60 − 8:20 = 3:40.
• (C) 4:20.
• (D) 4:40.
tip: ► Clock Mirror Formula: Actual Time = 11:60 − Mirror Time = 11:60 − 8:20 = 3:40! Solved in 2 seconds.

subject: Reasoning
q: Question: Among five friends P, Q, R, S, and T, who is the tallest? Statements: I. P is taller than Q but shorter than R. II. S is taller than T but shorter than P.
opts: Both statements I and II together are sufficient
explanation:
Correct Answer: (C) Both statements I and II together are sufficient • (A) Statement I alone.
• (B) Statement II alone.
• (C) Both together sufficient: Correct! Stmt I gives R > P > Q. Stmt II gives P > S > T. Combining both gives R > P > S > T and P > Q. Thus R is definitively the tallest among all five.
• (D) Neither sufficient.
tip: ► Chain Alignment: Stmt I: R > P. Stmt II: P > (S, T). Since P is taller than Q, S, T, and R is taller than P, R MUST be the tallest!

subject: Reasoning
q: Complete the alphanumeric pattern: A2Z, C4X, F8U, J16Q, ?
tip: ► Independent Progressions: 1st letter increments (+2, +3, +4, +5) to O; middle doubles to 32; last letter decrements (-2, -3, -4, -5) to L!

subject: Reasoning
q: If 'AIR' is coded as '28' and 'BIRD' is coded as '34', how will 'COP' be coded in that code?
explanation:
Correct Answer: (A) 36 • (A) 36: Correct! A(1) + I(9) + R(18) = 28. B(2) + I(9) + R(18) + D(4) = 33? If +1 added: 33 + 1 = 34. For COP: C(3) + O(15) + P(16) = 34 + 1? Or direct sum: C(3) + O(15) + P(16) = 34. If code is 36, sum + number of letters (34 + 3 - 1). Option A is 36.
• (B) 38.
• (C) 42.
• (D) 44.
tip: ► Alphabet Positional Sums: Compute direct place values: C(3) + O(15) + P(16)!

subject: Reasoning
q: A man walks 6 km West, turns right and walks 8 km. How far is he from his original starting point?
explanation:
Correct Answer: (A) 10 km • (A) 10 km: Correct! 6 km West and 8 km North forms a right triangle. Hypotenuse = √(6² + 8²) = 10 km.
• (B) 14 km: Distance walked.
• (C) 12 km.
• (D) 8 km.
tip: ► 6-8-10 Triplet: Hypotenuse = √(36 + 64) = 10 km!

subject: Reasoning
q: Statements: 1. All radios are electric. 2. All electric things are modern. Conclusions: I. All radios are modern. II. Some modern things are radios.
explanation:
Correct Answer: (C) Both I and II follow • (A) Only I follows.
• (B) Only II follows.
• (C) Both follow: Correct! Radios ⊂ Electric ⊂ Modern. All Radios are Modern (I follows). Modern circles contains Radios, so Some Modern are Radios (II follows by converse).
• (D) Neither.
tip: ► Transitive Chain: A ⊂ B and B ⊂ C implies A ⊂ C! Both conclusions are valid.

subject: Reasoning
q: If 1st January 2024 was a Monday, what day of the week was 31st December 2024?
explanation:
Correct Answer: (B) Tuesday • (A) Monday: If it were an ordinary year.
• (B) Tuesday: Correct! 2024 is a LEAP year (366 days). In a leap year, the last day of the year is ONE day ahead of the first day! Monday + 1 day = Tuesday.
• (C) Wednesday.
• (D) Sunday.
tip: ► Leap Year Day Shift: An ordinary year ends on the SAME day it begins. A leap year ends on the NEXT day! Monday + 1 = Tuesday!

subject: Reasoning
q: Select the odd pair among the following:
explanation:
Correct Answer: (D) Thermometer : Chemist • (A) Telescope : Astronomer: Correct standard tool.
• (B) Stethoscope : Doctor: Correct standard tool.
• (C) Microscope : Biologist: Correct standard tool.
• (D) Thermometer : Chemist: Odd pair! Thermometer is a general clinical/meteorological instrument, while chemists primarily use beakers, burettes, flasks, and spectrometers.
tip: ► Scientific Instrument Pairing: Telescope/Astronomer, Stethoscope/Doctor, Microscope/Biologist are hallmark vocational identifiers!

subject: Reasoning
q: In a code language: 'ri mo te' means 'police chase thief', 'te po ku' means 'thief ran fast', 'ku sa ri' means 'fast police siren'. What is the code for 'chase'?
explanation:
Correct Answer: (A) mo • (A) mo: Correct! 'ri mo te' = 'police chase thief'; 'te po ku' = 'thief ran fast' (common 'te' = 'thief'); 'ku sa ri' = 'fast police siren' (common 'ri' = 'police'). Leftover in 1st sentence is 'mo' = 'chase'.
• (B) ri = police.
• (C) te = thief.
• (D) ku = fast.
tip: ► Elimination Cross-Check: 'te' is thief, 'ri' is police -> 'mo' is uniquely chase!

subject: Reasoning
q: Pointing to a man in a parade, a woman said, 'His mother is the only daughter of my mother.' How is the woman related to the man?
explanation:
Correct Answer: (A) Mother • (A) Mother: Correct! 'Only daughter of my mother' for a female speaker is herself. If the man's mother is herself, the woman is his Mother.
• (B) Aunt.
• (C) Sister.
• (D) Grandmother.
tip: ► Self-Reference: 'Only daughter of my mother' = Myself. 'His mother is me' -> I am his mother!

subject: Reasoning
q: If North-East becomes South, North-West becomes East, and so on, what will South become?
explanation:
Correct Answer: (B) North-West • (A) North-East.
• (B) North-West: Correct! NE becomes South (135° clockwise rotation). South rotated 135° clockwise: South -> South-West (45°) -> West (90°) -> North-West (135°).
• (C) South-West.
• (D) North.
tip: ► Constant Rotation: Shift is 135° clockwise. South + 135° clockwise = North-West!

subject: Reasoning
q: Find the missing number in the matrix: [Row 1: 5, 4, 41; Row 2: 7, 3, 58; Row 3: 6, 8, ?]
tip: ► Sum of Squares Pattern: Column 1² + Column 2² = Column 3! 6² + 8² = 36 + 64 = 100!

subject: Reasoning
q: If each consonant in the word 'INVESTIGATION' is replaced by the preceding letter in English alphabet and each vowel is replaced by the following letter, which letter will appear thrice in the new word?
explanation:
Correct Answer: (C) J • (A) M.
• (B) R.
• (C) J: Correct! Vowels are replaced by following letters (I->J, E->F, A->B, O->P). The letter 'I' appears three times in 'I-N-V-E-S-T-I-G-A-T-I-O-N'. Each 'I' becomes 'J', so 'J' appears 3 times!
• (D) S.
tip: ► Vowel Target: Count the most frequent vowel: 'I' appears 3 times. 'I' + 1 = 'J', so 'J' appears three times!

subject: Reasoning
q: Statements: Most high-speed road fatalities in the state involve drivers without seatbelts or helmets. Conclusions: I. Wearing seatbelts and helmets significantly increases passenger survival rates. II. Government should cancel the driving licenses of all vehicle owners.
explanation:
Correct Answer: (A) Only conclusion I follows • (A) Only I follows: Correct! Evidence showing fatalities correlate with lack of seatbelts/helmets supports the inference that wearing them enhances survival. Canceling all licenses is an extreme, absurd measure.
• (B) Only II follows.
• (C) Both follow.
• (D) Neither.
tip: ► Pragmatic Inference: High-yield data confirms protective equipment works. Disproportionate mass penalties are never valid conclusions.

subject: Reasoning
q: A person starts from point A and walks 20 m North to B, turns right and walks 30 m to C, turns right and walks 20 m to D. What is the shortest distance between A and D?
explanation:
Correct Answer: (B) 30 m • (A) 20 m.
• (B) 30 m: Correct! A to B = 20 m North. B to C = 30 m East. C to D = 20 m South. Point D is directly East of A by 30 m.
• (C) 40 m.
• (D) 50 m.
tip: ► Rectangular Symmetry: 20 m North and 20 m South cancel out. Distance between A and D is strictly the horizontal leg = 30 m!

subject: Reasoning
q: In an examination of 80 students, 50 passed in Physical Test, 40 passed in Written Test, and 15 failed in both. How many students passed in both tests?
explanation:
Correct Answer: (B) 25 • (A) 20.
• (B) 25: Correct! Failed both = 15 -> Passed at least one = 80 - 15 = 65. Passed both = 50 + 40 - 65 = 25.
• (C) 30.
• (D) 35.
tip: ► Both Passed = A + B - (Total - Failed Both) = 50 + 40 - 65 = 25!

subject: Reasoning
q: Find the odd one out among: 35, 48, 63, 80, 99, 122
tip: ► n² - 1 Pattern: 35, 48, 63, 80, 99 are all one less than a perfect square. 122 is 121 + 1 (one MORE than a square)!

subject: Reasoning
q: Statements: 1. No officer is corrupt. 2. All honest people are officers. Conclusions: I. No honest person is corrupt. II. Some officers are honest.
explanation:
Correct Answer: (C) Both I and II follow • (A) Only I.
• (B) Only II.
• (C) Both follow: Correct! Honest ⊂ Officers, and Officers disjoint from Corrupt. Thus No Honest is Corrupt (I follows). Since Honest ⊂ Officers, Some Officers are Honest (II follows).
• (D) Neither.
tip: ► Disjoint Enclosure: If set A is inside B and B cannot touch C, A cannot touch C!

subject: Reasoning
q: Complete the series: 3, 10, 24, 52, 108, ?
tip: ► Double Plus Four: (Term × 2) + 4! 108 × 2 + 4 = 216 + 4 = 220!

subject: Reasoning
q: In a row of boys, if A is 10th from the left and B is 9th from the right, and on swapping places A becomes 15th from the left, how many boys are in the row?
explanation:
Correct Answer: (B) 23 • (A) 22.
• (B) 23: Correct! Total = (New rank of A + Old rank of B) - 1 = 15 + 9 - 1 = 23.
• (C) 24.
• (D) 25.
tip: ► Interchange Rule: Total = New + Old - 1 = 15 + 9 - 1 = 23!

q: Arrange the words in a logical procedural sequence: 1. FIR Filing, 2. Arrest, 3. Investigation, 4. Charge-sheet, 5. Trial in Court
explanation:

• (B) 1, 2, 3, 4, 5: Correct! FIR registered -> Accused arrested -> Investigation finalized -> Charge-sheet filed in court -> Judicial trial conducted.
• (C) 2, 1, 3, 4, 5.
